clue.text: Fine meal left to be eaten by two couples

indicators.note: being eaten by something means going inside it, so the first piece takes in the second

parts.note: two couples make four

explanation.surface: A gourmet's dainty dish left for two pairs of diners to finish off.
explanation.definitionFit: Flour is grain ground to a fine powder, the finest form of meal.

clue.text: Awesome female — fair, too

parts.note: rightful means just or fair

explanation.surface: A woman is admired as both impressive and beautiful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'too' is a link. 'Awesome' is used in its old sense of inspiring dread.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words once meant inspiring terror or dread.

clue.text: Ancient metal that's no good

indicators.note: being no good means the good is taken away

parts.note: golden means made of gold, the metal

explanation.surface: An old piece of metal turns out to be worthless.
explanation.definitionFit: Olden is a poetic word for old times, long ago.

clue.text: Scientific basis for long trips in locomotive on railway

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits on top of the second

parts.note: Stephenson's Rocket was a famous early steam locomotive

explanation.surface: Long journeys by steam train rest on scientific principles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is a link; long trips are space journeys.
explanation.definitionFit: The science of propulsion by jet reaction underlies space travel.

clue.text: Decorate dress of bride more fancily

indicators.note: to dress something is to arrange it, so these letters are set out afresh

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A seamstress is asked to trim the wedding gown more lavishly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of' is a link and 'fancily' rounds off the surface while hinting at the fanciful sense of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To embellish cloth with needlework is to adorn it, and figuratively to add fancy details to a story.

clue.text: Makes 'ot snacks

definitions.meaning: heats said with the dropped h of Cockney speech

explanation.definitionFit: Heats without its H gives the informal word for food.

clue.text: Creature often fed on rock

parts.note: the Rock is Gibraltar, where tourists feed the famous tailless macaques

explanation.definitionFit: The macaques of Gibraltar, known as the Rock, are often fed by visitors.

clue.text: Doubts persist at regular intervals to fill the mind

indicators.note: taking every other letter, starting with the second, picks out the run

explanation.surface: Lingering doubts keep coming back to preoccupy someone.
explanation.definitionFit: To preoccupy someone constantly is to haunt their thoughts.

clue.text: One's nearly always at the forefront in work

definitions.text: One's nearly always at the forefront in work

parts.words: One's nearly always at the forefront in work
parts.note: the person to whom a book is dedicated is named at the front of the work

explanation.definitionFit: The person a book is inscribed to is named on its opening pages.

clue.text: Frost, we hear, used to write poetry

indicators.note: says the word is to be judged by its sound

parts.note: rime is hoar frost

explanation.surface: Robert Frost, the poet, is said to have written verse.
explanation.walkthrough: Robert Frost was an American poet, a deliberate distraction.
explanation.definitionFit: Matching end sounds are a device poets use to compose verse.

clue.text: What points Conservative in Asian country to right?

indicators.note: one piece sits inside the other, so the country is wrapped round the party letter

parts.note: India is a country in Asia
taken as written

explanation.surface: A question about where a Tory in India should turn to find the political right.
explanation.definitionFit: A pointer or needle on a dial is a device that shows a reading by pointing.

clue.text: Unfortunately secretive over information about product

indicators.note: here over means covering on both sides, so the first piece goes round the second

parts.note: sly means furtive or secretive
an ad is an advertisement, information about a product

explanation.surface: Regrettably, the firm stayed tight-lipped about its product details.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words are adverbs expressing regret, in the sense of 'regrettably'.

clue.text: Watch railway engine losing head of steam

indicators.note: losing something means it is taken away from the word before

parts.note: a shunter is a locomotive that moves wagons about in a yard

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A steam engine runs out of puff in a railway yard.
explanation.definitionFit: A hunter is a pocket watch with a hinged metal cover protecting the glass.

clue.text: Make a killing in service area

parts.note: Mass is a church service
an acre is a measure of area

explanation.surface: Someone hopes to profit hugely at a motorway service station.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Make a killing' suggests a financial windfall; here it is literal slaughter. 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To slaughter many people at once is the literal sense of the idiom.

clue.text: Lisa's upset after admirer and sweetheart found wine

indicators.note: after says the next piece follows the two before it

parts.note: a beau is a male admirer
jo is a Scots word for sweetheart

indicators.note: upset means knocked over or disturbed, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the possessive adds no letter

explanation.surface: Lisa is upset to find her admirer with a sweetheart over a bottle of wine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' rearranges LISA to LAIS; 'found' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Beaujolais is a red wine from the region of that name in Burgundy.

clue.text: Reeds fully obscured iris

indicators.note: obscured suggests the letters are muddled out of recognition

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Tall reeds by the water completely hide an iris.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is the heraldic lily of France, which is also a name for the iris flower.
explanation.definitionFit: The heraldic emblem is traditionally thought to depict a stylised iris flower.

clue.text: Hot food left in hacienda when cooked?

indicators.note: the letter goes inside the word that follows
cooking suggests the letters are mixed and altered

explanation.surface: A Mexican cook prepares spicy dishes left in the hacienda kitchen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts L inside HACIENDA; 'when cooked' rearranges the result.
explanation.definitionFit: An enchilada is a spicy Mexican dish of a tortilla rolled round a filling.

clue.text: Good breeding is expected from this boss

definitions.text: Good breeding is expected from this
definitions.meaning: a stallion or farm kept for breeding horses
a raised knob or boss on a surface

explanation.definitionFit: A breeding stallion and an ornamental raised knob share this name.

clue.text: Soft soap possibly needed to restrain man

parts.note: to deter is to hold back or discourage
a gent is a gentleman, a man

explanation.surface: Soft soap may be required to hold back an advancing man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Soft soap' suggests flattery; here it is literal soap, an example of the answer, hence 'possibly'. 'needed to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Soft soap is one kind of cleaning agent, so it is an example.

clue.text: Made a list of some guides I met in climbing

indicators.note: in a down clue, climbing means reading upwards, so the run is turned round
some of these words supply the run

explanation.surface: A climber made a list of the mountain guides met on the ascent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'some' picks DESIMETI from 'guiDES I MET In'; 'climbing' reverses it.
explanation.definitionFit: To set out items one by one is to list them.

clue.text: Fish out of a northern lake

indicators.note: the letter is taken out of the fish's name

parts.note: the loach is a small freshwater fish

explanation.surface: An angler pulls a fish from a lake in the north.
explanation.walkthrough: A LOCH is a Scottish lake, hence 'northern'.
explanation.definitionFit: A loch is the Scottish word for a lake, Scotland lying in the north of Britain.

clue.text: In error, one's taken in by obvious hospital visitor

parts.note: out means wrong, as in a calculation being out

indicators.note: being taken in by something means going inside it

parts.note: patent means plain or obvious
one is I, the Roman numeral; the 's is 'is'

explanation.surface: Someone is plainly fooled by an obvious error.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who attends hospital for treatment without staying overnight is visiting it.

clue.text: Legendary queen, one betrayed to English

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
sold means betrayed, as in sold out

explanation.surface: A queen of legend is handed over to the English.
explanation.definitionFit: Isolde was the Irish princess and Cornish queen in the Tristan legend.

clue.text: Wooden panelling and child's furniture put on wagons

indicators.note: one piece placed after the other, the bed loaded on the wagons

parts.note: a wain is an old word for a farm wagon
a cot is a child's bed

explanation.surface: Panelling and a baby's bed are loaded onto carts for removal.
explanation.definitionFit: Lining the lower part of a room's walls with oak boards is the classic sense.

clue.text: Old person -Eisenhower, for example — dismissing Democrat

indicators.note: dismissing someone means removing them

parts.note: Dwight was Eisenhower's first name

explanation.surface: Eisenhower, a Republican, is said to have fired a Democrat.
explanation.definitionFit: A wight is an archaic word for a human being.

clue.text: Cause harm to one married couple

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
a pair is a couple

explanation.surface: Someone sets out to damage a newly-wed couple.
explanation.definitionFit: To weaken or damage something is to injure it.

clue.text: Brutish person's limited inner personality

indicators.note: limited means cut short, so the final letter goes

parts.note: a brutish person is an animal

explanation.surface: A brute is said to have a limited inner self.
explanation.definitionFit: In Jungian psychology, the anima is the inner self or soul.

clue.text: In the course of the opening of a Shakespearean comedy

indicators.note: the opening keeps only the start of the title

parts.note: A Midsummer Night's Dream is a Shakespeare comedy

explanation.surface: Something happens during the first scene of a Shakespeare play.
explanation.definitionFit: Amid means in the middle of, during.

clue.text: King has become sick after end of quest

parts.note: GR stands for Georgius Rex, King George
to ail is to fall ill

explanation.surface: A king falls ill after his quest is over.
explanation.walkthrough: The Holy Grail is the object Arthurian knights sought, so it is literally the end of the quest. 'has' and 'after' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: The holy cup sought by Arthur's knights was the goal of their search.

clue.text: It's a crime, perhaps, putting an end to engagement

indicators.note: perhaps signals the letters could be another arrangement

parts.note: taken as written, the apostrophe ignored
taken as written

explanation.surface: Breaking off an engagement is described as nothing short of a crime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'engagement' suggests a betrothal; here it is a military engagement, a battle.
explanation.definitionFit: A truce halts fighting between armies, ending the battle.

clue.text: Went over part of song in jazz setting

indicators.note: a setting holds something, as a ring holds a stone, so jazz goes round the song part

parts.note: trad is traditional jazz
a verse is a section of a song

explanation.surface: A singer reviews part of a song in a jazz arrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: To cross or pass over ground is to travel across it.

clue.text: Duke gets right to the back in military call-up

parts.note: aft means at the back of a ship

explanation.surface: A duke is ordered to the rear when conscripted.
explanation.definitionFit: Conscription into the armed forces is called the draft, chiefly in America.
